bio: In the heart of historic Bordeaux, this cosy, casual eatery dishes up deftly crafted bistronomic cuisine that stars carefully sourced produce: poached oysters, mousse of ham and samphire pickles; pigeon marinated in oriental spices and a combo of turnips and harissa jus. Don’t miss the cocktail-food pairings, the house signature, concocted by Jodie....
